script_text: The cosmic veil is lifting, and a massive shift is demanding your attention. Early this week, Mars in your 10th House forms a tense square to Saturn, making career decisions feel heavy and restrictive through Tuesday. Wednesday brings a reprieve as your ruler, Venus, forms a harmonious sextile to Jupiter, opening a lucrative window for financial growth. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday when the Moon enters your 5th House, shifting the focus from labor to passion. Late week, a trine between Neptune and your 7th House brings a dreamy, romantic clarity to your long-term partnership. Saturday offers a blissful connection, while Sunday requires grounding your Earth element. Tuesday is your hardest day due to the Saturnian friction in your professional life. Friday is your power day because Venus stabilizes your romantic sector. Stop overthinking your value and start claiming it. Follow for daily updates.
